Smooth monodromy, circle quotients and integral return classes
AI-produced mathematical text
18 November 2026
Abstract
The smooth returns of the specified compact complex six-sphere families are calculated in
Θ7 = Z/28 with their actual physical circle, parameter closing and cusp fan. The original
shorter (3, 4) scalar family realizes every class by varying its basis fan; its class on the vertical
fan T2 is 26, refuting the previous scalar norm polynomial. The OS45 reference family has
class 3, and its positive parameter covers realize every class. The fixed-edge rule for the
specified page returns is multiplication by 7. Complete source and cap comparisons give the
OS49, E7 and E6 return sectors. For the selected E6 order-three source loop the physical
Jin pair is (−27, −12) and the all-fan class is −4 + 3(S −1)/2 −27(S2 −1)/8 modulo 28,
where S = x2 + xy + y2 and (x, y)t = P −1e2; its image has sixteen elements. The selected-
infinity loop has initial physical pair (−4, 8) and the full fourteen-odd-class fan image for
both complete cap progressions, M6 with m = 3l + 2 and M2 with m = 3l, including both
primitive norm signs and every retained finite character and annular reference. For the original
selected-I3 source loop, the quadratic M6 cap has initial physical pair (47, −4) and realizes
all twenty-eight classes by explicit native fan words. The full selected-height, signed-meridian
and proper cap-product comparison extends both integers and every native fan map to all
reduced M6 caps and both primitive norm signs. The M2 order-three source loop has physical
pair (−3, −12) throughout every stated good cap and both primitive norm signs. Its full fan
integer is −3(S −1)(S −3)/8, with the sixteen-element residue set displayed in the complete
proof. Each cap comparison uses the common strict scalar range with its specified reference.
The proofs retain the source, line, finite-character and normal maps through every fan change.
The physical dual-line comparison fixes the orientation, and an integral prism recurrence
computes the fan dependence. Historical checks, current re-derivations and exact certificate
executions are recorded separately for each statement. The remaining attachment problem is
stated with its precise scope.

and Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) at effort max for the readings, checks and plans of 12–17
November 2026. S6_06_BLIND is credited as a re-derivation with access to preceding material.
Each statement records the actual check scope and preserves the names, effort settings and dates
of its historical checks.

The archive’s literal settings are retained with their model, provider, interface
and date. OpenAI documents reasoning allocation controls (OpenAI, 2026b, sections “Reasoning
effort” and “Reasoning mode”) and maps ChatGPT’s Pro selection to GPT-6 Pro, powered by
GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI, 2026a, section “Choose a thinking level”). Anthropic documents effort as
control of response-token use, including thinking (Anthropic, 2026, sections “How effort works”
and “Effort levels”). The check event states what was read, re-derived or executed.
